text: {"category": "application", "summary": "pick-planner aborts on an uncaught std::out_of_range while it plans the route of a pick list: route_seconds calls aisles_.at(task.aisle) with aisle 12 on a vector of 12 aisles. Container planner in pod pick-planner-5f6d7c8b9-vn2rt is in CrashLoopBackOff after 6 restarts, so pick waves are not planned.", "root_cause": "route_seconds (src/pick_planner.cpp, lines 9-17) looks each task's aisle up with aisles_.at(task.aisle). main gives the planner the 12 aisles A01 to A12, which sit at the indexes 0 to 11, but the tasks name aisles by number, and aisles are numbered from 1. A task for aisle 12 asks for index 12, at() throws std::out_of_range (__n (which is 12) >= this->size() (which is 12)), nothing catches it, and the process aborts. Floor layout v2, deployed with 2.2.0, has 12 aisles, so a pick list that visits the last aisle crashes the planner.", "confidence": "high", "evidence": [{"id": "log:previous:planner", "why": "The planner terminates on an uncaught std::out_of_range, index 12 of a vector of size 12, thrown in route_seconds at src/pick_planner.cpp line 13."}, {"id": "code:snippet:1", "why": "route_seconds indexes the aisles with aisles_.at(task.aisle) and does not turn the aisle number into an index."}, {"id": "code:snippet:2", "why": "main builds the planner with the 12 aisles A01 to A12."}, {"id": "dd:event:8312004415592873027", "why": "pick-planner 2.2.0 brought floor layout v2, with 12 aisles signed A01 to A12."}, {"id": "k8s:status:planner", "why": "Container planner is in CrashLoopBackOff after 6 restarts; its last run exited with code 1."}], "suspected_code": [{"snippet_id": "code:snippet:1", "path": "src/pick_planner.cpp", "start_line": 9, "end_line": 17, "symbol": "route_seconds"}], "recommended_actions": ["In route_seconds, turn the aisle number into an index (task.aisle - 1) and reject a task whose aisle is not between 1 and the number of aisles.", "In main, catch the error of one pick list, log it and move the file aside, so that one bad list cannot stop the planner.", "Add a test with a pick list that visits the last aisle."], "needs_human": false}
